Name: JetBrains sunsets Edu IDEs
Milestone: In the repositioning of JetBrains Academy, starting with EduTools 2022.11, new releases of IntelliJ IDEA Edu and PyCharm Edu were discontinued. Instead, users were advised to install IntelliJ IDEA Community Edition or PyCharm Community Edition, as these now include educational features by default, streamlining access to learning tools within the JetBrains ecosystem.

Name: PyCharm Edu announced
Milestone: With the launch of PyCharm Educational Edition, we began experimenting with the in-IDE learning concept, bringing professional development tools into the world of computer science education.

Name: EduTools plugin: Python, Java and Kotlin
Milestone: With the release of the EduTools plugin, we expanded the in-IDE learning approach beyond PyCharm, bringing it to Java and Kotlin within IntelliJ IDEA.

Name: Educational Products by JetBrains announced
Milestone: The announcement of Educational Products by JetBrains marked the first step towards a more generalized educational brand and product pipeline, with the main focus still on in-IDE learning and teaching.

Name: Partnering with Stepik (Hyperskill)
Milestone: In May 2018, with our educational products pipeline in mind, we chose to collaborate with Stepik, focusing on project-based learning. We believed that project-based learning could effectively complement in-IDE learning. This partnership ultimately led to the development of Hyperskill in November 2018.

Name: JetBrains Academy name
Milestone: We chose the name JetBrains Academy after conducting naming research. Our goal was to find a suitable name for all our educational initiatives and products, both current and future, that would highlight our intention to establish an educational brand, rather than just a single product.

Name: JetBrains Academy (Hyperskill) goes public
Milestone: We initiated the Early Access Program (EAP) for JetBrains Academy, with Hyperskill as its first and only member, focusing on project-based learning, a knowledge map, and JetBrains IDEs integration. Our aim was to introduce a paid subscription and leverage the EAP to attract early users.

Name: Paid subscription announced
Milestone: We announced JetBrains Academy's transition from Early Access to a subscription model, asking for user feedback. Additionally, we offered free access to all EAP users until January 1, 2021, followed by a 50% discount on a one-year subscription thereafter.

Name: JetBrains Academy EAP is closed
Milestone: We transitioned from the EAP to a paid subscription model, introducing a free 7-day trial and a special 3-month extended trial to new users. For those registered before October 1, we offered a 50% discount on a one-year subscription, aiming to boost our first sales.

Name: IntelliJ IDEA Edu announced
Milestone: We launched IntelliJ IDEA Edu, an educational IDE version, blending IntelliJ IDEA Community's features with the EduTools plugin to support programming learning and teaching. It extends its programming language support to include Scala, alongside Java and Kotlin, enhancing its utility for a wider educational audience.

Name: JetBrains Academy and Hyperskill repositioning
Milestone: To address confusion and growth challenges, JetBrains decided to distinguish between the Hyperskill and JetBrains Academy brands. JetBrains Academy will serve as a content provider for Hyperskill, which will emerge as a learning platform with distinct branding. This strategic separation aims to optimize both entities' development and marketing efforts.

Name: JetBrains renames EduTools plugin to JetBrains Academy plugin
Milestone: The renaming of the EduTools plugin to the JetBrains Academy plugin represented a step towards a more coherent and simplified vision for JetBrains Academy, aligning with the refreshed strategy for educational products at JetBrains.

Name: JetBrains announces the new vision for JetBrains Academy
Milestone: With over a million global users of our educational products, it was time to publicly launch the expansive JetBrains Academy brand. This initiative aims to consolidate all our educational products, programs, and efforts under a single, unified brand.

Name: Hyperskill stops selling new personal subscriptions via JetSales
Milestone: The repositioning of JetBrains Academy included halting its subscription sales via JetSales and launching Hyperskill subscriptions. Aimed at aligning user experiences and recognition with the Hyperskill brand, this move sought to distinguish Hyperskill from JetBrains, focusing on a clearer and more specific brand identity.

Name: Hyperskill launches the freemium model
Milestone: After conducting experiments, Hyperskill shifted to a freemium model, offering a free plan that included access to all tracks with certain limitations. These restrictions involved personalization of study plans, a fixed number of problems that could be solved daily, availability of hints and solutions per problem, and code quality checks.

Name: JetBrains introduces Marketplace for courses
Milestone: JetBrains Marketplace has evolved to include not just plugins but also a repository for educational courses. Educators globally can share their expertise through courses developed within the EduTools plugin and Educational IDEs, designed for immersive hands-on experience within JetBrains IDEs.

Name: JetBrains Academy’s course catalog
Milestone: To merge project-based and in-IDE learning under the JetBrains Academy brand, we introduced a unified course catalog at http://academy.jetbrains.com/. This platform serves as a central hub for computer science education and tech skills advancement, streamlining access to comprehensive learning materials.
